{{Quote|A lot of those repulsi-veyer lines are over fifty kilometers long|Lando Calrissian, on the repulsi-veyer lines of the Sarnus Refinery|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
A '''repulsi-veyer line''' was a type of transportation system. At the [[Sarnus Refinery]], an industrial complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] owned by the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], repulsi-veyer lines of up to fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length were used to transport [[astrolith]]s&mdash;crushed [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fragments&mdash;from a series of crash pits to refining mills for processing.<ref name="Crucible" />

==Behind the scenes==
Repulsi-veyer lines appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
